tiles.title: Release to warehouse transaction log
tiles.description: Shows the tracing log data from the release to warehouse process

tiles.title: Warehouse mobile app devices
tiles.description: A list of warehouse mobile app devices used in the timeframe defined with information about each device

parameters.description: The legal entity that the release to warehouse process runs for
The release to warehouse batch job
Environment that the telemetry came from

queries.text:
customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend BatchJobCaption = customDimensions.BatchJobCaption
| where BatchJobCaption contains "release" and BatchJobCaption !startswith "'Export process"
and BatchJobCaption !startswith "Export" and BatchJobCaption !startswith "Import"
and BatchJobCaption !startswith "Move to staging"
| extend EnvironmentId   = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId)
| where  EnvironmentId in (_environmentId) or isempty(_environmentId)
| extend BatchJobId = tostring(customDimensions.BatchJobId)
| where isempty(_batchJob) or BatchJobId in (_batchJob)
| extend LegalEntity = tostring(customDimensions.LegalEntity)
| where isempty(_legalEntity) or LegalEntity in (_legalEntity)
| extend SalesId = tostring(customDimensions.orderNumber)
| extend eventId = customDimensions.eventId
| extend eventStatus = customDimensions.eventStatus
| extend warehouseId = customDimensions.warehouseId
| extend waveId = customDimensions.waveId
| extend waveProcessingId = customDimensions.waveProcessingId
| extend waveStatusCurrent = customDimensions.waveStatusCurrent
| extend itemId = customDimensions.itemId
| extend loadId = customDimensions.loadId
| extend workCreationNumber = customDimensions.workCreationNumber
| extend workOrderType = customDimensions.workOrderType
| extend workType = customDimensions.workType
| extend requestedInventoryQuantity = customDimensions.requestedInventoryQuantity
| extend shipmentId = customDimensions.shipmentId
| extend workCreationLogFailed = customDimensions.workCreationLogFailed
| extend workCreationLogMessage = customDimensions.workCreationLogMessage
| extend ["Step name"] = name
| project timestamp, BatchJobId, LegalEntity, BatchJobCaption, ["Step name"], eventId, eventStatus, warehouseId, waveProcessingId, waveId, 
  SalesId, shipmentId, loadId, workCreationNumber, workCreationLogFailed, workCreationLogMessage,
  workOrderType, workType, requestedInventoryQuantity
| order by BatchJobId asc, timestamp asc

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend BatchJobCaption = customDimensions.BatchJobCaption
| where BatchJobCaption contains "release"
| extend EnvironmentId   = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId)
| where  EnvironmentId in (_environmentId) or isempty(_environmentId)
| extend BatchJobId = tostring(customDimensions.BatchJobId)
| where isempty(_batchJob) or BatchJobId in (_batchJob)
| extend LegalEntity = tostring(customDimensions.LegalEntity)
| where isempty(_legalEntity) or LegalEntity in (_legalEntity)
| extend SalesId = tostring(customDimensions.orderNumber)
| where isnotempty(SalesId) and SalesId != "<empty>"
| distinct LegalEntity, BatchJobId, SalesId

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend BatchJobCaption = customDimensions.BatchJobCaption
| where BatchJobCaption contains "release"
| extend EnvironmentId   = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId)
| where  EnvironmentId in (_environmentId) or isempty(_environmentId)
| extend BatchJobId = tostring(customDimensions.BatchJobId)
| where isempty(_batchJob) or BatchJobId in (_batchJob)
| extend LegalEntity = tostring(customDimensions.LegalEntity)
| where isempty(_legalEntity) or LegalEntity in (_legalEntity)
| extend SalesId = tostring(customDimensions.orderNumber)
| extend eventId = customDimensions.eventId
| extend eventStatus = customDimensions.eventStatus
| extend warehouseId = customDimensions.warehouseId
| extend waveId = customDimensions.waveId
| extend waveProcessingId = customDimensions.waveProcessingId
| extend waveStatusCurrent = customDimensions.waveStatusCurrent
| extend itemId = customDimensions.itemId
| extend loadId = customDimensions.loadId
| extend workCreationNumber = customDimensions.workCreationNumber
| extend workOrderType = customDimensions.workOrderType
| extend workType = customDimensions.workType
| extend requestedInventoryQuantity = customDimensions.requestedInventoryQuantity
| extend shipmentId = customDimensions.shipmentId
| extend workCreationLogFailed = customDimensions.workCreationLogFailed
| extend workCreationLogMessage = customDimensions.workCreationLogMessage
| where isnotempty(workCreationNumber) and eventStatus != "stop" and eventStatus != "start" and workCreationLogFailed == 0
| project timestamp, BatchJobId, LegalEntity, BatchJobCaption,  warehouseId, waveId, 
  SalesId, shipmentId, loadId, workCreationLogMessage, requestedInventoryQuantity
| order by BatchJobId asc, timestamp asc

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend activity = tostring(customDimensions.activityGraph)
| where name startswith "Warehouse.MobileApp.Warehouse.MobileApp.ClientRoundTrip" or activity == "Warehouse.MobileApp.Interaction"
| extend legalEntity = tostring(customDimensions.lastKnownDataAreaId)
| where isnotempty(legalEntity)
| where isempty( _legalEntity) or legalEntity in (_legalEntity)
| extend environmentId = tostring(customDimensions.serverEnvironmentId)
| where isempty( _environmentId) or environmentId in (_environmentId)
| extend warehouseId = tostring(customDimensions.lastKnownWarehouse)
| where isnotempty(warehouseId)
| extend appVersion = tostring(customDimensions.appVersion)
| extend deviceId = tostring(customDimensions.deviceId)
| extend deviceBrand = tostring(customDimensions.deviceBrand)
| extend deviceModel = tostring(customDimensions.deviceModel)
| extend devicePlatform = tostring(customDimensions.devicePlatform)
| extend devicePlatformVersion = tostring(customDimensions.devicePlatformVersion)
| extend batteryLevel = tostring(customDimensions.devicePlatformVersion)
| extend wifiSignal = tostring(customDimensions.wifiSignalStrength)
| extend networkConnection = tostring(customDimensions.networkConnectionProfiles)
| summarize ["Legal Entity"]=max(legalEntity), ["Warehouse"]=max(warehouseId), ["App Version"] = max(appVersion), ["Device brand"]=max(deviceBrand), ["Device Model"]=max(deviceModel), 
["Device Platform"]=max(devicePlatform), ["Platform Version"]= max(devicePlatformVersion), ["Battery Level"] = any(batteryLevel), ["network connection"] = any(networkConnection), ["Wifi Strength"]=any(wifiSignal) 
by deviceId 
| project ["Legal Entity"], ["Warehouse"], deviceId, ["App Version"], ["Device brand"], ["Device Model"], ["Device Platform"], ["Platform Version"], ["Battery Level"], ["network connection"],["Wifi Strength"]
| order by ["Legal Entity"] asc, ["Warehouse"] asc, deviceId asc

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend legalEntity = tostring(customDimensions.LegalEntity)
| where legalEntity != "" and legalEntity != "dat"
| distinct legalEntity
| order by legalEntity asc

customEvents
| where     timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend    customDimensionsParsed = parse_json(customDimensions)
| where isempty(_legalEntity) or tostring(customDimensionsParsed.LegalEntity) in (_legalEntity) 
| extend    BatchJobId  = tostring(customDimensionsParsed.BatchJobId)
| where BatchJobId != "" and BatchJobId != "0"
| extend    BatchJobCaption = tostring(customDimensionsParsed.BatchJobCaption)
| where BatchJobCaption contains "release" and BatchJobCaption !startswith "'Export process"
and BatchJobCaption !startswith "Export" and BatchJobCaption !startswith "Import"
and BatchJobCaption !startswith "Move to staging"
| extend BatchJob = strcat(BatchJobId, " - " , BatchJobCaption) 
| distinct  BatchJobId, BatchJob
| order by  BatchJob asc

let environmentList=(pageViews
| union exceptions
| union customEvents
| union customMetrics
| union traces
| where timestamp  between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where client_Type == "PC" // exclude CDS
| extend Dims = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend environmentId = tostring(Dims.environmentId)
| where environmentId != ""
| distinct environmentId);
environmentList
| lookup  kind=leftouter (environments) on $left.environmentId == $right.Id
| extend EnvironmentName = iif(environmentName =="", environmentId, environmentName) 
| project environmentId, EnvironmentName
| sort by EnvironmentName asc
